item.title: Nava surges to Santiago shock against Berrettini
item.description: Emilio Nava outserved former Top 10 star Matteo Berrettini to notch a statement upset on Tuesday at the BCI Seguros Chile Open. The No. 79 in the PIF ATP Rankings breezed to a 6-3, 6-4 opening-round victory in Santiago. Nava, who was making his main-draw debut at the clay ATP 250, saved all three break points he faced and won 84 per cent (32/38) of first-serve points against Berrettini, according to Infosys ATP Stats. item.title: When Nadal ended Federer's dominance in Dubai final classic
item.description: March 2006. The height of Roger Federer’s dominance. The Swiss had owned the No. 1 spot in the PIF ATP Rankings for more than two years. item.title: Wawrinka bids farewell to Dubai after 'one last chance' vs. Medvedev
item.description: Stan Wawrinka was honoured under the desert sun on Wednesday afternoon, when he played his final match at the Dubai Duty Free Tennis Championships. The Swiss wild card, who triumphed at the ATP 500 event in 2016, fell to Daniil Medvedev in straight sets before staying on court for a touching farewell ceremony. item.title: Griekspoor upsets Bublik, Rinderknech ousts Draper in Dubai
item.description: Tallon Griekspoor was forced to wait two years for a fifth crack at defeating Alexander Bublik. Griekspoor upset the second-seeded Bublik 6-3, 7-6(4) to seal his quarter-final berth at the hard-court ATP 500.
